40019389.author: पदार्थः
40019389.content: काकुत्स्थे Kakuthsa, Dasharatha प्रतिप्रयाते returned, पाकशासनः the tamer of demon Paka, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, परमप्रीतः very affectionately, प्राञ्जलिम् saluting with joined palms, स्थितम् stood, राघवम् Raghava, अब्रवीत् spoke

40019389.author: Translation
40019389.content: Mahendra, the tamer of demon Paka, spoke very affectionately to Rama, who stood with joined palms before Dasharatha who had returned.

40019390.author: पदार्थः
40019390.content: नरर्षभ bull among men, राम Rama, तव your, अस्माकम् yourself, दर्शनम् sight, अमोघम् amazing, प्रीतियुक्ताः happy, स्म in your, तेन so, मनसा in your mind, यत् that which, ईप्सितम् desiring, त्वम् you, ब्रूहि may tell

40019390.author: Translation
40019390.content: "O Rama, a bull among men! Your sight was amazing, and we are happy. Please tell us the desire in your mind?"

40019391.author: पदार्थः
40019391.content: प्रसन्नेन gratified, महात्मना great soul, महेन्द्रेण to Mahendra, एवम् in this way, उक्तः said, राघवःRaghava, सुप्रसन्नात्मा very pleased, हृष्टः happy, वचनम् words, प्राह submitted

40019391.author: Translation
40019391.content: Gratified by Mahendra's words, Raghava was very happy and pleased, submitting to him as follows.

40019392.author: पदार्थः
40019392.content: वदतांवर good at expression, विबुधेश्वर Lord of gods, ते you, मयि my, प्रीतिः happiness, समुत्पन्नायदि has risen, मे my, वचनम् words, सत्यम् true, कुरु make it

40019392.author: Translation
40019392.content: "O Lord of gods, you are one who is good at expression. If happiness has risen in, you please make my words true."

40019393.author: पदार्थः
40019393.content: ममहेतोः for my cause, पराक्रान्ताः who fought, ये those, वानराः Vanaras, यमसादनम् abode of Yama, गताः reached, तेसर्वे all of them, जीवितम् life, प्राप्य get back, समुततिष्ठन्तु make them rise up

40019393.author: Translation
40019393.content: "The Vanaras have fought for my cause and reached the abode of Yama. Make them rise up and get them back to life."

40019394.author: पदार्थः
40019394.content: मानद honourable, मत्कृते for my sake, ये they, वानराः Vanaras, पुत्रैः sons, दारैश्च wives, विप्रयुक्ताः seperated for good, तान् them, सर्वान् all, प्रीतमनसः delighted, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि I wish

40019394.author: Translation
40019394.content: "O honourable Indra! I wish to see all those Vanaras who are separated forever from their sons, and wives for my cause, delighted."

40019395.author: पदार्थः
40019395.content: विक्रान्ताः च valiant, शूराश्च courageous, मृत्युम् death, न गणयन्ति च not cared for, कृतयत्नाः did utmost, विपन्नाःच fallen into adversity, पुरन्दर Purandara, destroyer of citadels, एतान् all of them, जीवय bring to life

40019395.author: Translation
40019395.content: "They were valiant and courageous and did not care for life. They did their utmost, died and fell into adversity. Purandara! Get all of them back to life."

40019396.author: पदार्थः
40019396.content: मत्प्रियेषु at death, अभिरक्ताः fond of doing, ये they, मृत्युम् death, न गणयन्ति not counted, ते they, त्वत्प्रासादात् by your grace, समेयुः in war, अहम् I, एतम् all of them, वरम् boon, वृणे seek

40019396.author: Translation
40019396.content: "They were fond of doing and not counted death. I seek your grace to give a boon to relieve all of them from death."

40019397.author: पदार्थः
40019397.content: मानद bestower of honour, गोलाङ्गूलान् longtailed monkeys, तथा similarly, वक्षांश्च Bears, नीरुजः purified without any pain, निर्व्रणांश्चैव from death, सम्पन्नबलपौरुषान् enriched with strength and courage, द्रष्टुम् to see, इच्छामि desire

40019397.author: Translation
40019397.content: "Bestower of honour! I wish to see the longtailed Vanaras, and Bears rid of pain and death, enriched with strength and courage."

40019398.author: पदार्थः
40019398.content: वानराः Vanaras, यत्र there, तिष्ठेयुः living, तत्र there, अकालेचापि even though out of season, पुष्पाणि flowers, मूलानि च and roots, फलानि च fruits, विमलाः pure, नद्यश्च rivers

40019398.author: Translation
40019398.content: "Let the location where Vanaras lived, have flowers, roots, fruits even though out of season and rivers with pure water."

40019399.author: पदार्थः
40019399.content: महात्मनः great self, तस्य his, राघवस्य Raghava's, वचनम् words, श्रुत्वातु hearing also, महेन्द्रः Mahendra, प्रीतिसंयुतम् replied, इदम् this, वचनम् words, प्रत्युवाच in turn

40019399.author: Translation
40019399.content: Hearing high souled Raghava's words, Mahendra in turn replied as follows.

40019400.author: पदार्थः
40019400.content: तात dear, रघूत्तम foremost of Raghus, यः that which, त्वया by you, उक्तः sought, अयम् this, वरः boon, महान् great, मया by me, वदिः asked, न उक्तपूर्वम् even before you asked, तस्मात् therefore, एतत् everything, एवम् in that way, भविष्यति will be granted

40019400.author: Translation
40019400.content: "Dear Rama! that which has been sought by you is great. Nothing has been revised by me in the past. Therefore, everything asked by you will be granted by this boon."

40019401.author: पदार्थः
40019401.content: ये those, युधि combat, राक्षसैः by the Rakshasas, हताः killed, तेसर्वे all of them, निकृत्ताननबाहवः severed arms and heads deformed, गोपुच्छैः long tailed, ऋक्षाश्च Bears, समुत्तिष्ठन्तु duly rise to life

40019401.author: Translation
40019401.content: "Let those long tailed Vanaras and Bears killed by Rakshasas, whose heads and arms had been severed, duly rise to life."

40019402.author: पदार्थः
40019402.content: हरयः monkeys, नीरुजः healed, निर्व्रणाश्चैव from death, सम्पन्नबलपौरुषाः enriched with strength and power, सुप्ताः sleeping, निद्राक्ष्येयथा like rising from sleep, समुत्थास्यन्ति rise up

40019402.author: Translation
40019402.content: The monkeys duly healed, so also from death, enriched with strength and power rose up like rising from sleep.

40019403.author: पदार्थः
40019403.content: सर्वेएव all in that way, परया, मुदा happily, सम्युक्ताः reunited, सुहृद्भिः highly rejoiced, बान्धवैश्चैव with relatives, ज्ञातिभिः own clan, स्वजनेन own people, समेष्यन्ति will get united

40019403.author: Translation
40019403.content: "Let all in that way happily get reunited and highly rejoiced, with relatives, own clan and own people get united."

40019404.author: पदार्थः
40019404.content: महेष्वास wielder of great bow, पादपाः trees, अकाले unseason, पुष्पशबलाः with blossom, फलवन्तश्च and with fruits, भविष्यन्ति will be, नद्यश्च rivers, सलिलायुताः remain with water

40019404.author: Translation
40019404.content: The trees will be with blossoms and fruits even though it is unseasonal. The rivers will remain with waters.

40019405.author: पदार्थः
40019405.content: ततः then, सर्वे all, हरियूथपाः army of Vanaras, प्रथमम् earlier, सव्रणैः of the wounds, इदानीम् these, निर्व्रणैः dead, समैः united, गात्रैः limbs, सुप्त्वेव having slept, समुथतिताः like getting up, सर्वे all, वानराः Vanaras, एतत् these, किंनु What happened, इति this, विस्मिताः amazed, बभूवुः became

40019405.author: Translation
40019405.content: All the army of Vanaras healed from the wounds, who were earlier covered with wounds and all the dead monkeys together rose up like getting up from sleep. They were amazed and started saying 'What happened'!

40019406.author: पदार्थः
40019406.content: सर्वे all, सुरोत्तमाः best of suras, परिपूर्णार्थम् fully accomplished, काकुत्थ्सम् to Kakuthsa, दृष्टवाseeing, परमप्रीताः very affectionately, सलक्ष्मणम् and Lakshmana, रामम् Rama, स्तुत्वा praised, अब्रुवन् spoken

40019406.author: Translation
40019406.content: Seeing all of them fully accomplished, the best of Suras very affectionately praised Rama and Lakshmana and spoke.

40019407.author: पदार्थः
40019407.content: राजन् king, इतः from here, अयोध्याम् Ayodhya, गच्छ return, वानरान् Vanaras, विसर्जय च leaving, अनुरक्ताम् very dear, यशस्विनीम् illustrious, एनाम् this, मैथिलीम् Mythili, सान्त्वयस्व assuring

40019407.author: Translation
40019407.content: "King, return from here to Ayodhya leaving the monkeys. Reassure Mythili, who is very dear to you and an illustrious one."

40019408.author: पदार्थः
40019408.content: परन्तप subduer of enemies, त्वच्छोकात् grief due to separation from you, व्रतचारिणम् devoted, भ्रातरम् brothers, भरतम् Bharata, महात्मानम् great souls, शत्रुघ्नं च and Satrughna, सर्वाः all, मात्रूः mothers, पश्य see, आत्मानम् you, अभिषेचय consecrate, गत्वा reaching, पौरान् people, प्रहर्षय rejoice

40019408.author: Translation
40019408.content: "Subduer of enemies! See your brothers, great souls Bharata and Satrughna devoted to you who are in grief due to your separation, see your mothers. Get consecrated. People will rejoice.

40019409.author: पदार्थः
40019409.content: परन्तप subduer of enemies, त्वच्छोकात् grief due to separation from you, व्रतचारिणम् devoted, भ्रातरम् brothers, भरतम् Bharata, महात्मानम् great souls, शत्रुघ्नं च and Satrughna, सर्वाः all, मात्रूः mothers, पश्य see, आत्मानम् you, अभिषेचय consecrate, गत्वा reaching, पौरान् people, प्रहर्षय rejoice

40019409.author: Translation
40019409.content: "Subduer of enemies! See your brothers, great souls Bharata and Satrughna devoted to you who are in grief due to your separation, see your mothers. Get consecrated. People will rejoice.

40019410.author: पदार्थः
40019410.content: सहस्राक्षः thousand eyed Indra, सौमित्रिणासह with Saumithri, रामम् Rama, एवम् in that way, उक्त्वा having spoken, हृष्टः delighted, सुरैःसह with Suras, सूर्यसङ्काशैः resembling sun, विमानैः aerial car, ययौ returned

40019410.author: Translation
40019410.content: The thousand eyed Indra, having spoken in that way to Rama and Saumithri, delighted, they returned to heaven in an aerial car with Suras.

40019411.author: पदार्थः
40019411.content: तदा then, भ्रात्रा brother, लक्ष्मणेनसह with Lakshmana, काकुत्स्थ : Kakuthsa, तान् those, सर्वान् all, त्रिदशोत्तमान् jewels among gods, अभिवाद्य greeting, वासम् home, आज्ञापयत् ordered

40019411.author: Translation
40019411.content: Then greeting all the jewels among gods present there, accompanied by brother Lakshmana, Kakuthsa Rama ordered all Vanaras to go home and rest.
